intro.text: A small creature of Roshar with a flat tail, two large claws and long antennae, served steamed as food.

description.text: At a Kholinar tavern where Wit has a job entertaining, he and Shallan are given Soulcast grain cakes, each with a steamed skrip on top. Shallan finds the dish not terrible and eats Wit's share too.
